notes.title: 10/08/2016 Major Update
notes.notes:
Release Notes:

1. ACTIVATION SYSTEM: We completely changed the product activation system. It is less intrusive, works better, works in more major countries without manual activation. 

2. FREE TRIAL: The activation screen will automatically issue a free trial without contacting our support staff. Just click the Free 10 Day Trial button. (Only works once per device)

3. SYSTEM TRAY MENU: The System Tray icon now has a right-click menu to quickly access certain options. (User Requested)

4. PASSCODE LOCK: We updated the passcode feature to re-lock automatically a few seconds after your passcode is entered; until you turn it off. We also fixed a bug where the passcode stops working if your MAC Address changes. (User Requested)

5. GAMING MODE: You can now close the "Gaming Mode" window. Windows Non-Essential Services option is removed and only part of Max Boost mode. (User Requested)

6. GENERAL BUG FIXES: We have optimized the code and fixed several bugs. 

We will continue to add more user requested features at no charge. If you have found an issue that is not addressed or if this version causes any new issues for you then please let us know

You can install this update over your existing installation. It will prompt you to activate the software again in most cases since we completely replaced the old product activation system.

To get the update from our website:
Go to www.seventhknight.com and download the product.
Save the product to your desktop. Right-Click and "Run As Administrator".
Install and activate the product. 

Installation Note: IF YOU DO NOT WANT TO RE-SCAN AT INSTALL:
On the first screen of the Seventh Knight Installer where it asks to Install or Remove:
Move your mouse to the upper left hand corner of the Window. A menu appears. 
Change your drive scan option.
